Description: A viral infection that attacks your respiratory system. Symptoms include fever, chills, muscle aches, cough, congestion, runny nose, headaches and fatigue.
Symptoms: Fever, cough, sore throat, body ache, fatigue
Precautions: Annual flu vaccine, hand hygiene, stay home when sick

Description: A disease caused by parasites transmitted by infected mosquitoes. Symptoms include fever, chills, and flu-like illness. Can be life-threatening if not treated.
Symptoms: Fever, chills, headache, vomiting, sweating
Precautions: Use mosquito nets, take antimalarial medication, seek immediate care

Description: An infectious disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. Most people experience mild to moderate respiratory illness. Older people are at higher risk.
Symptoms: Fever, cough, difficulty breathing, loss of taste
Precautions: Wear masks, practice social distancing, get vaccinated

Description: A bacterial infection affecting the lungs. Symptoms include chronic cough with blood, fever, night sweats, and weight loss.
Symptoms: Cough, weight loss, night sweats, fever, chest pain
Precautions: Complete TB medication, cover mouth when coughing, maintain nutrition

Description: A viral infection of the upper respiratory tract. Symptoms include runny nose, sneezing, sore throat, cough, and mild fever.
Symptoms: Runny nose, sneezing, sore throat, cough, mild fever
Precautions: Rest, drink fluids, use over-the-counter remedies, hand washing

Description: An infection that inflames air sacs in the lungs. Symptoms include cough with phlegm, fever, chills, and difficulty breathing.
Symptoms: Fever, cough, chest pain, difficulty breathing, fatigue
Precautions: Get pneumococcal vaccine, avoid smoking, complete antibiotics

Description: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines. Symptoms include diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and cramping.
Symptoms: Diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, nausea, fever
Precautions: Stay hydrated, oral rehydration, rest, bland diet

Description: A serious liver infection caused by hepatitis B virus. Can cause chronic infection and leads to risk of cirrhosis and liver cancer.
Symptoms: Yellow skin, fatigue, abdominal pain, dark urine, fever
Precautions: Get vaccinated, practice safe sex, avoid sharing needles

Description: A condition where blood pressure is too high. Usually has no symptoms. Can lead to heart disease and stroke.
Symptoms: Headache, dizziness, chest pain, shortness of breath
Precautions: Reduce salt, maintain weight, exercise, limit alcohol

Description: A chronic condition affecting blood sugar processing. Occurs when body doesn't produce enough insulin or doesn't respond properly.
Symptoms: Frequent urination, thirst, fatigue, blurred vision
Precautions: Monitor blood sugar, healthy diet, exercise, medication

Description: A chronic condition caused by HIV. Damages the immune system over time. Requires lifelong treatment.
Symptoms: Fever, weight loss, fatigue, swollen lymph nodes, night sweats
Precautions: Take ART daily, safe sex, regular checkups, healthy lifestyle

Description: A medical emergency when blood flow to the brain is interrupted. Brain cells die within minutes. Requires immediate medical attention.
Symptoms: Sudden numbness, confusion, difficulty speaking, severe headache
Precautions: Call emergency immediately, note time of onset, keep person calm

Description: A range of conditions affecting the heart. Includes coronary artery disease, heart rhythm problems, and heart defects.
Symptoms: Chest pain, shortness of breath, nausea, dizziness, sweating
Precautions: Heart-healthy diet, exercise, don't smoke, limit alcohol

Description: A condition where airways narrow and swell. Makes breathing difficult and triggers coughing, wheezing, and shortness of breath.
Symptoms: Wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, coughing
Precautions: Use inhaler, avoid triggers, monitor breathing, have action plan

Description: Swelling and tenderness of joints. Main symptoms include joint pain and stiffness that worsen with age.
Symptoms: Joint pain, swelling, stiffness, reduced mobility
Precautions: Stay active, maintain weight, hot/cold therapy, medication

Description: A neurological condition causing severe headaches. Often accompanied by nausea, vomiting, and sensitivity to light.
Symptoms: Severe headache, nausea, sensitivity to light, dizziness
Precautions: Rest, dark room, pain relief, avoid triggers

Description: An immune response to normally harmless substances. Symptoms include sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes, and skin rash.
Symptoms: Sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes, skin rash, coughing
Precautions: Antihistamines, avoid allergens, clean environment

Description: Inflammation of the bronchial tubes. Causes coughing, production of mucus, fatigue, shortness of breath, and mild fever.
Symptoms: Cough, mucus, fatigue, shortness of breath, mild fever
Precautions: Avoid smoking, rest, medication, breathing exercises

Description: Inflammation of the sinuses. Symptoms include facial pain, nasal congestion, headache, and reduced sense of smell.
Symptoms: Facial pain, nasal congestion, headache, reduced smell
Precautions: Nasal irrigation, rest, hydration, pain relief

Description: An infection in any part of the urinary system. Symptoms include frequent urination, pain during urination, and lower abdominal pain.
Symptoms: Frequent urination, pain during urination, lower abdominal pain
Precautions: Drink water, empty bladder, hygiene, see doctor
